title: Papieren Pack
description: One Pack: weighted Tells and a Threshold. A Post is hidden when the weights of the Tells it meets add up to the Threshold, each Tell counted once. At most 300 Tells over tells and every language, in a file of at most 256 KB. Papieren's own validator has the final word; this schema documents it.

id.description: Unique among your Packs; a Pack of your own may not take a built-in Pack's id.

kind.description: junk: a kind of post, such as engagement bait; topic: a subject, such as football. Both match the same way.

from.description: Only on a copy of a built-in Pack: the built-in's id and version it was copied from.

tells.description: Tells applied whatever the Post's language: name, bio, shape, media and context.

languages.description: Text Tells per language code as X gives it, for example en or pt-br, applied only to Posts in that language.

weight.description: A whole number from -10 to 10, not 0. A negative weight pulls a Post back.

phrase.description: Whole words, ignoring case, after Unicode NFKC folding; a run of spaces matches any run of whitespace.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, matched with flags iu against the folded text. Refused: a backreference; more than three quantifiers, or more than one that repeats (*, +, {m,}, {m,n}); a repeated group holding a quantifier or |.

textTell.description: The Post's own visible text, at most 500 characters; a quote is judged on its own text only.

authorTell.description: The Author's display name or bio; for a repost, both Authors'.

shapeTell.description: emoji and hashtags: counts; caps: the share of capital letters, 0 to 1, known only with 20 cased letters or more; lines: non-empty lines per sentence; length: characters.

mediaTell.description: has: the Post carries that kind of media or a link; domain: a link to that host or any of its subdomains.
